subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should this issue be owned by the open prompt-projection fix, by a broader gateway/session lifecycle repair, or by a maintainer live-repro investigation before any new fix PR is queued?
rationale: The issue has multiple credible release reproductions, but current source points to at least one narrower unfixed projection path while the full gateway-triggered wedge may span session lifecycle and recovery behavior.

options.title: Review PR 99524 First
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 as the immediate source-isolated candidate, then require live validation before closing this broader issue.

options.title: Broaden To Lifecycle Repair
options.body: Pause the narrow patch and ask for a maintainer-owned investigation across gateway restart deferral, session locks, compaction, and reset recovery before landing code.

options.title: Live Repro Only
options.body: Hold implementation until reporters provide raw logs or maintainers reproduce the wedge on current main with one of the named sessions.

recommendation.title: Review PR 99524 First
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 as the immediate source-isolated candidate, then require live validation before closing this broader issue.
